title.hr: Prvo ukloniti opasnost: redoslijed mjera zaštite
title.en: Remove the hazard first: the order of controls

concept.hr: Rizik je vjerojatnost × posljedica; mjere koje treba pamtiti najčešće zakažu
concept.en: Risk is likelihood × severity; controls someone must remember fail most often

summary.hr: Četiri scene, pet razina mjera: rizik na papiru i na dan, i 200 ponavljanja u kojima se brifing i oprema ponekad zaborave.
summary.en: Four scenes, five levels of control: the risk on paper and on the day, and 200 runs in which briefings and PPE are sometimes forgotten.
